verdict.rationale: Kommo documents event-triggered automation, such as reactions to lead stage changes and website visits, a SalesBot scenario editor, and appointment reminders and follow-ups. None of these shows a way to set up recurring, time-based scheduled jobs or workflows. Event triggers and one-off reminders do not stand in for a recurring schedule, so this applicable axis has no evidence of delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
